title: Mirror task codes inside a random intrinsic subspace
hypothesis: After all task updates are fitted in the same frozen random intrinsic subspace, one shared intrinsic vector plus compact Givens Mirror coordinates represents aligned tasks with lower serialized task-code bytes than ordinary intrinsic coefficients, while unrelated tasks fall back to private intrinsic coordinates.
physical_object: one fitted 128-value shared base plus a deterministic 128x32 random orthonormal projection basis
mirror_coordinate: one int8 scalar per accepted task rotating a shared 32-value intrinsic vector; private 32-value intrinsic coefficient fallback
logical_multiplicity: eight task functions: five aligned intrinsic-coordinate tasks and three unrelated tasks
controls: ordinary random-subspace intrinsic task vectors (mandatory PA33 control)
Mirror orbit code plus private intrinsic-coordinate fallback

task.teacher: first task defines shared base; next four deltas are Givens-orbit members in the random subspace; final three deltas are unrelated random subspace vectors
task.metric: mean normalized held-out output MSE from deserialized payload

development.selection_metric: smallest fixed validation threshold accepting all four non-anchor aligned tasks and rejecting all unrelated tasks to private intrinsic fallback

fresh.access_condition: Development selects one threshold; fresh evaluation reports quality, actual payload, fit/view-search compute and throughput without retuning.

training.optimizer: least-squares fit in frozen random intrinsic basis; deterministic grid fit of task angles

storage.authority: actual deterministic compact serialized inference payload bytes
storage.serialization: uint16 JSON-header length plus little-endian state tensors
paid_objects: all task coefficient or Mirror angle/private coordinate codes
projection seed and deterministic QR recipe metadata
full independent task vectors in upper reference

gates.promising: In all three fresh worlds: all four aligned non-anchor tasks use Mirror coordinates; unrelated tasks use private intrinsic coordinates; Mirror normalized MSE <=1e-4; payload <=0.85x ordinary intrinsic task-vector payload; and full decode/fit operation proxy <=2x ordinary intrinsic control.
gates.fail: Mirror misses quality in >=2 fresh worlds or payload saving is <10% in >=2 worlds, or aligned tasks require private fallback in >=2 worlds.
gates.not_established: invalid splits, serialization/replay mismatch, or incomplete worlds

boundaries: synthetic linear functions in a random low-dimensional subspace
random-subspace fitting is analytical post-fit screen, not language-model training
no near-convergence capacity or learned task inference claim
